crossRefs.note: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:
The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah…
He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.
The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness…
For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and…
“You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up…
on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,

people.name: Dibon
people.line: Moabite city, allotted to Gad, later possessed by Moab.

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Kenath
people.line: A city in Gilead, captured by Nobah and renamed

people.name: Medeba
people.line: A Moabite city captured by the Israelites

translations.web: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”
translations.bsb: But we have overthrown them; Heshbon is destroyed as far as Dibon. We demolished them as far as Nophah, which reaches to Medeba.”
translations.kjv: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
translations.asv: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, And we have laid waste even unto Nophah, Which reacheth unto Medeba.
